display_name: MT103 to MX Translation Fidelity Scorer
description: Scores ISO 15022 MT103 to ISO 20022 pacs.008 translation fidelity for the CBPR+ migration (structured-address date deferred by Swift on 27 Aug 2026, new date not published). Checks field presence mapping (:20: to UETR, :50K/A to Dbtr/Nm, :59/:59A to Cdtr/Nm, :52A/:57A to BIC agents, :70: to RmtInf/Ustrd, :71A to ChrgBr), truncation risks (140-char remittance info, address line lengths), and charge bearer code mapping (OUR=DEBT, SHA=SHAR, BEN=CRED). Outputs fidelity score and per-field mapping results. A missing, null, empty or whitespace-only required field yields an INDETERMINATE verdict instead of a positive fidelity result.

output.cbpr_plus_deadline_status: deferred by Swift on 27 Aug 2026; no new date published

mapping_results.note: :20: is the MT reference; pacs.008 requires a new UUIDv4 UETR (not a direct carry-over of :20:).
:50K: 4 lines x 35 chars; Dbtr/Nm allows 140 chars. Name truncation risk if MT line contained both name and account on same line.
:59: 4 lines x 35 chars; Cdtr/Nm max 140 chars. Beneficiary name + address must be split into Nm and PostalAddress24 in pacs.008.
:52A BIC carries directly to DbtrAgt/BICFI. Direct 1-to-1 mapping.
:57A BIC carries directly to CdtrAgt/BICFI. Direct 1-to-1 mapping.
:70: allows 4 lines x 35 chars = 140 chars. RmtInf/Ustrd max 140 chars. Near-identical capacity but line concatenation must not lose data.
OUR->DEBT, SHA->SHAR, BEN->CRED. Direct table mapping.

output.pii_note: MT and pacs.008 field values are processed structurally (presence, length, code mapping). No real party PII processed. Use synthetic message fields for testing.
output.regulatory_basis: SWIFT CBPR+ mandatory migration; Swift notice of 27 Aug 2026 (structured-address date deferred, no new date published);SWIFT MT103 Standards Release Guide; ISO 20022 pacs.008.001.10
